intended_behavior: Modify __init__ to add a private boolean flag _is_new_session. Set it to True if the session is newly created (did not exist previously), otherwise False.

Update initialize() to check _is_new_session flag; if True, skip the read_agent call and directly create the agent and its messages in the repository. If False, preserve existing behavior of reading and restoring an existing agent.

Similar to initialize(), update initialize_bidi_agent() to skip read_agent if _is_new_session is True and directly create the bidi agent and messages. Preserve existing behavior for existing sessions.
Update initialize_multi_agent() to check _is_new_session and skip the read_multi_agent call if True, directly creating the multi-agent state. Otherwise, keep current behavior.
